title: A Cross-Lingual Analysis of Bias in Large Language Models Using Romanian History

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting multiple LLMs with controversial historical statements across four different languages (Romanian, English, Hungarian, Russian) to measure cross-lingual consistency and stance reversals using forced binary (Yes/No) answers, 1-10 numerical scale ratings, and LLM-as-a-judge evaluations of generated essays.

Analyzing the divergence in model responses to specific geopolitical and historiographical disputes (e.g., Romanian versus Hungarian historical narratives) to evaluate how models reflect the dominant cultural narratives embedded within their language-specific training data.
